text:
Lia (Support): Hey team, customer on Dedicated is seeing streaming stop after ~90-120s idle. They get partial SSE then client reconnects but sees 401 on reconnects.
Aj (SRE): Any logs? upstream 5xx or ALB messages?
Lia (Support): Pasting minimal repro client they used:
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream?model=gpt-4o" \
  | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Lia (Support): Repro: leave connection idle for ~2m, server sends keepalive earlier but connection gets silent -> client gets a cut and then reconnects, second request fails with 401. Customer says it works when they route direct to origin bypassing Cloudflare.
Sasha (Runtime): :eyes: Which load balancer? ALB, NLB, Cloudflare? Any proxy in front? Also what network path?
Lia (Support): Cloudflare (WAF + CDN) in front of our ALB. We see in our logs connection reset after 125s.
Aj (SRE): 125s is suspiciously close to some proxies' idle breakpoints. Could be ALB or Cloudflare buffering/keepalive suppression. Can you paste the proxy logs and the request/response trace?
Lia (Support): from access logs:
```text
2025-11-02T14:12:34Z client_ip=1.2.3.4 request_id=abc upstream_status=200 bytes_sent=1234 duration=121.8
2025-11-02T14:14:36Z client_ip=1.2.3.4 request_id=abc upstream_status=499 bytes_sent=1234 duration=125.2
```
Aj (SRE): 499 => client closed before upstream finished. Might be Cloudflare or the client closing. Also the 401 on reconnect suggests auth token rotation or cookie/session logic treating the reconnect as invalid.
Sasha (Runtime): For streaming we rely on TCP half-close and regular SSE comments. Some proxies will coalesce or drop empty keepalives. Workaround: instruct client to emit periodic application-level heartbeats or newline pings. We already send keepalives but they may be stripped by the CDN.
Aj (SRE): Action items:
- Capture tcpdump at edge + ALB during a repro window
- Check Cloudflare "buffering"/HTTP2 settings and origin keepalive behavior
- Verify token validation path on reconnects (auth service logs)
- Provide client-side heartbeat snippet as a mitigation
Lia (Support): Customer agreed to try client heartbeat. Sent them this quick example:
```bash
# crude client heartbeat: send a newline every 20s to keep the TCP flow alive for some proxies
while sleep 20; do printf "\n"; done &
# then start the streaming curl in foreground
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-..." "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/stream?model=gpt-4o"
```
DeployBot: Incident INC-2025-384 created and assigned to Aj (SRE).
Aj (SRE): Pulling tcpdump now. If proxy is terminating at ~125s we should consider requesting an ALB idle timeout bump or changing Cloudflare origin settings; also confirm if HTTP/2->HTTP/1 hybrid is causing windows to close.
Sasha (Runtime): If the customer can't change their CF config, recommend direct origin route to Dedicated endpoint (bypass CDN) or WebSocket fallback for workloads that must remain idle for long periods.
Lia (Support): I'll send the logs + the incident link to the customer and propose the heartbeat + direct-origin options. They want repro steps and a short mitigation checklist.
Aj (SRE): I'll attach the pcap and a short writeup once I have captures.
Lia (Support): Thanks all. I'll close the loop once we confirm root cause or the client confirms heartbeat mitigates it. :thumbsup:
